signature.one_line: Podcast holds carried by word-by-word caps captions completed by a glowing accent script line.
unique_devices: Two typographic tiers per phrase: UPPERCASE extra-bold geometric line, then a lowercase monoline connected script completion in pale accent with a glow
Script line tucked up so its tall ascenders overlap the bottom of the caps line
Pre-laid-out lines revealed word by word in place with 5-10 frame opacity fades, 2-8 frames after each spoken word
Warm creamy 'beauty' grade with bloom and strong sharpening on a high-key beige set
signature.why_it_works: Constant word reveals give motion to 7-8 s static holds; the script tier makes the phrase ending feel like a personal, emotional punch.

hook.type: Direct address (imperatives to 'you' from word one)
hook.first_frame: motion-blurred zoom into a 3/4-angle podcast medium close-up (mic in frame) that is sharp within ~15 frames

structure.what: zoom-blur pull into the speaker; three quick commands to the viewer
L-trail cut to a second angle; freedom gives courage to stand up for yourself
soft cut to a ~115 % tighter crop for the defiant punchline

captions.what: two-tier caption block: caps line 1 + script line 2
captions.how: line 1 Poppins 800 57 px, +0.04 em, warm white, soft dark shadow, centre y 62.0 % of 1920 (69.2 % of the 9:10 picture), max ~75 % W; line 2 monoline script ~66 px pale accent with outer glow, centre y 64.7 %, ascenders overlapping line 1
each word fades 0->100 % over 5-8 f (script words 6-10 f), no scale / slide, 2-8 f after the spoken word; line 2 starts after line 1 completes; block hard-cuts out, 2-3 empty frames before the next

layout.how: 720x800 source; for 9:16 delivery place it full-width (1080x1200 at y 360-1560) or crop full-bleed and keep the caption on the lower chest below the mic

camera.how: radial zoom blur scaling in to the MCU, sharp by frame ~15; first word on frame 1
~115 % digital crop of the same angle, entered with a soft cut

transitions.what: L-trail hard cut to a second angle
transitions.how: audio of the previous phrase trails over the new angle

transitions.what: soft cut into the tight crop
transitions.how: short dissolve / blur into the ~115 % crop

captions_spec.script: latin (Roman Hinglish). Transcribers may return Devanagari; captions are Roman transliterations of the same speech

grouping.words_per_caption: line 1: 1-5 words, line 2: 1-5 words (one spoken phrase split across the two tiers: opening words in caps, completion in script)
grouping.sync: word by word on both tiers: each word fades in on its spoken word, in its final position of the pre-centred line
grouping.break: new two-tier block per phrase; the previous block hard-cuts out, then a 2-3 frame empty gap

line2.align: centre (x 50 %) of the full phrase; the script's tall ascenders overlap the bottom ~1 % of line 1

layout.reveal_note: each line is laid out for the whole phrase first; words appear in place (the first word of a line shows left of centre, where it will sit in the finished line)

line1.font_class: geometric sans, extra-bold caps, slightly open tracking
line1.color: #EEE6E2 (warm white after the creamy grade; design value #FFFFFF)

line2.font_class: monoline handwritten connected script, lowercase, very tall ascenders, small x-height

closest_match.local_fallback: none of the local fonts is a script; Playfair Display italic only as a last resort

line2.size_note: no k factor for scripts: match ink height ~3.05 % of 1920 H (4.88 % of the 9:10 picture) for a two-word lowercase line spanning ~52 % W; start ~66 px
line2.color: #D2C974 measured core (pale lime-yellow under the warm grade; brighter design value ~#E5EB7A (estimated))

animation.line1_entry: word by word opacity fade 0 -> 100 % with no scale or move: measured ink 157 -> 438 -> 773 -> 1146 -> 1293 px at +1..+5 frames for a short word; longer words take ~8 frames
animation.line2_entry: same word-by-word fade in place, 6-10 frames per word; a final short word may follow ~7 frames after the previous one
animation.timing: each word appears 2-8 frames AFTER its spoken start (typically +3-5 f; up to +8 f on the first script word)
animation.exit: the whole two-tier block hard-cuts out at the phrase end, then 2-3 empty frames before the next block's first word

canvas_mapping.to_1080x1920: the 9:10 picture scaled to full width = 1080x1200, centred vertically (y offset 360 px). y_1920_pct = (360 + y_ref_pct/100 x 1200) / 19.2. Sizes scale x1.5 with width; ink % of H on 1920 = ink % of 800 x 0.625. If instead the edit is a full-bleed 9:16 crop of similar podcast footage, keep the reference % positions relative to the subject (caption on the lower chest, below the mic).
canvas_mapping.calibration_values_below: ink_pct_of_H in the type tiers is already mapped to the 1080x1920 canvas (x0.625); raw 9:10 values are in calibration_ref

other_text_spec.text: no titles, lower-thirds, logos, watermark, emoji or end card

line2_script.closest_local: none local; install Sacramento (monoline connected script)

style.look_intent: warm, creamy, high-key with lifted blacks, bloom/glow and strong sharpening; natural saturation; beige set

sound.music: music bed likely (heuristic, very low under continuous speech); soft emotional bed
sfx: optional whoosh on the zoom-blur intro (inferred)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Word-by-Word Pop Captions
catalog_styles.role: word-by-word in-place reveal (soft fades instead of pops)

catalog_styles.name: Handwritten Annotations
catalog_styles.role: glowing handwritten script tier completing each phrase

catalog_styles.name: Zoom-Through Transitions
catalog_styles.role: zoom-blur intro into the first frame

use_when: a single-speaker podcast or interview clip with few angles and long holds
emotional / motivational opinion lines where the phrase ending deserves emphasis
Hinglish or bilingual speech captioned in Roman script
a soft, warm, feminine or lifestyle brand look
avoid_when: fast information-dense explainers with numbers and lists
the brand cannot install a script font (no local script match)
footage is already sharp and contrasty (the glow + sharpen look will over-process it)
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B02 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B02.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship — text and accent must stay >= 4.5:1 / >= 3:1 against what sits behind them on the footage):
- {{TEXT}}      default #EEE6E2 (warm white caps line; #FFFFFF before a warm grade)
- {{ACCENT}}    default #E5EB7A (pale lime script line + glow)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  default none
- {{SURFACE}}   default none (captions sit on footage)
- {{CARD_BG}}   default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} default Poppins 800 (caps line)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    default a monoline connected script, e.g. Sacramento (completion line)
- {{HANDLE}}    default @handle
- {{LOGO}}      default the brand's logo file (transparent PNG/SVG)
The script line is thin: keep {{ACCENT}} light enough for >= 3:1 on the clothing behind it and keep its glow; if the brand accent is dark, use a light tint of it.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. The reference picture is 9:10 placed full-width (1080x1200 at y 360-1560); if your footage fills 9:16, keep the captions on the lower chest just below the mic (69 % / 74 % of the picture height).

CAPTIONS
1. Roman script as spoken (transliterate Devanagari). Split each phrase into two tiers: line 1 = first 1-5 words in UPPERCASE; line 2 = the completion (1-5 words) in lowercase script (placeholder 'LEAD WORDS' / 'key word here'). No punctuation, no emoji.
2. Line 1: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 57 px, tracking +0.04 em, {{TEXT}}, soft dark drop shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.45), no stroke / box. Centred; ink centre at 62.0 % H. Max line width ~75 % W.
3. Line 2: {{FONT_BODY}}, lowercase, {{ACCENT}}, soft outer glow 0 0 8px {{ACCENT}} at ~60 % opacity, centred with its centre at 64.7 % H so the tall ascenders overlap the bottom of line 1. Start at ~66 px.
4. Reveal: lay out the full two-tier phrase first, then reveal it word by word IN PLACE. Each word fades 0->100 % over 5-8 frames (script words 6-10), no scale / slide, starting 2-8 frames after the word is spoken. Line 2 begins after line 1 is complete.
5. Exit: the whole block hard-cuts out at the phrase end; 2-3 empty frames before the next block. No idle motion.

OTHER TEXT
6. None: no titles, lower-thirds, {{LOGO}}, watermark or end card.
7. Edit: open with a ~15-frame zoom-blur into the first MCU with the first word on frame 1; hold 7-8 s shots; L-trail cut to a second angle mid-way; soft cut to a ~115 % crop for the final line.

GRADE
Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: warm, creamy, high-key with bloom/glow and crisp sharpening, natural saturation.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render 'FINANCIALLY' on line 1 and a two-word placeholder 'key word' on line 2, then measure:
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.25,0.59,0.75,0.635 --ink "{{TEXT}}:45"
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.15,0.625,0.85,0.68 --ink "{{ACCENT}}:60"
   Expected (±0.5 % H, ±2 % W): 'FINANCIALLY' ink 2.11 % H / 37.6 % W at 57 px Poppins 800 +0.04 em. Script line: ink ~3.05 % H for a two-word lowercase line; adjust px from 66 until it matches.
b) Any other caps word / font: python3 video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "Poppins 800" --word "<WORD>" --upper --ink 2.11 --tracking 0.04 -> ~57 px. Measure over dark clothing, not the light set. (fit_font.py needs a target: --ink and/or --width; it returns the px that reproduces that ink for YOUR word plus the width it will read at that px. Requires Pillow.)
c) Positions within ±1 % H: line 1 centre 62.0 %, line 2 centre 64.7 %.
